body:
Independent new-work review of bd193092bfc07e0874505dc7f8ad79f1ee9609a8: BLOCKED by one P2 handshake defect (inline finding at randomx_iteration_engine.v:102). Please retain the scratchpad read grant until acceptance and add the stalled-read / arriving-write regression before acceptance.

Reviewed only the new converter, iteration controller, native oracle, testbench and driver; reused the accepted AES/tail base. Signed32 conversion (including INT32_MIN), F/E masks, tag/reset handling, ordered byte strobes, alias/chain accounting and dataset feedback agree with the pinned native logic for the documented serialized replay. The native arithmetic remains software execution/replay; this is controller integration evidence.

Read-only evidence checks matched the exact-head Git blobs and all 20 unchanged execution inputs; the sole changed driver hash matches the Icarus12 correction. Retained logs support 4,096 conversion vectors, eight RTL modes and A/C mapped ideal/stalled modes, 32 iterations (16 v2/16 v1), 2,880 reads, 720 stores, 256 tail writes and full 2 MiB comparison. Entry totals 1,056/544/480 follow the stated port model; generic A/C counts 126,810/130,589 exclude physical memory and arithmetic. They do not establish hardware arithmetic performance or full-hash throughput.

All five checks now pass on this exact head, including differential-engine run 38329486629. Existing CI does not exercise the overlapping kernel requests described in the finding. No new workload, build, test, synthesis or code edit was performed by this review; no merge.
